execution: Not run in this lane; independent source review and the root-owned admitted native browser run remain required. Runtime output is ignored test-results/debug-log-controls-acceptance.json.
profile: The existing owned-profile harness creates a disposable profile and removes it after execution; clear is scoped to that run only.
event_source: Runner compares actual scoped debug-event rows before and after natural public-page navigation/click. It does not write to the debug store or inject events. A missing positive event set keeps event-dependent targets unverified.
credentials: The runner mirrors the proven isolated-admin-signin-acceptance.mjs real UI sequence because that script is an executable entrypoint: open Settings Account, navigate the real web login form, read AI_ADMIN_USERNAME/AI_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the aidream env only when the form is ready, submit through the web UI, click extension Sign in, and verify exact account email, admin role, and Sign out in the real Settings UI. No auth storage injection, credential logging, or raw auth error reporting is used.
evidence: Runtime 001 reached verified real admin UI, then failed while DebugView's lazy-loading spinner was visible; the runner now waits for mounted Search/counter controls. Runtime 002 demonstrated warm message-search filtering, pause/resume, and clear, but did not prove detail search or expansion. The extended runner uses only natural rows: a unique detail-bearing row is expanded and collapsed through trusted pointer input, and a unique no-detail row is clicked to verify it stays non-actionable. A detail JSON key absent from every observed message may supply a private detail-only search term; the exact source row must remain visible after trusted filtering. No detail row or term leaves those parts unverified. Distinct no-match and no-events states are checked. The Debug error badge is observed before and after Clear; without a positive badge, badge clearing remains unverified. All case statuses remain partial or unverified because reload and service-error dimensions are outside this bounded run. Version and tree SHA are read from the release receipt and manifest before and after the owned native profile; older runtime receipts are not retroactively attributed to a build.
limitations: Source-only checks cannot establish that public-page interaction emits a debug event or that the runner's UI selectors remain stable in the built extension.
T14's detail-search branch stays unverified if no naturally observed detail-only JSON key can be safely identified and exercised.
